info.title: Second Memory API
info.description: Second Memory admin API. Admin routes authenticate with the Sanctum session cookie: call `GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie`, then `POST /admin/credential/login`, and send the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header on writes (ADR-0004). Every response uses the `{ data, error: { status, code, messages } }` envelope.

Skills and tags are names, not ids: unknown skills are reported, missing tags are created.

StoreEvidenceRequest.description:
Evidence is a link (ADR-0007) and/or files of the file manager (LEDGER-01, `media_ids` in display
order). EvidenceService checks the files are uploaded and that a link or a file is left (LEDGER-02). `source`, `external_key` and
`unpublished_at` belong to the importer (RFC-002 §4.5) and are not accepted here.

The slug is not editable either; public URLs stay stable across renames.
